LET’S ARRANGE YOUR ARRIVAL

BEFORE YOU TAKE THE WHEEL

A few things
you might ask.

Something else on your mind?
Just ask us on WhatsApp.

How do I reserve a car?

Send us your dates, preferred vehicle style and pick-up area using the enquiry form. It prepares a WhatsApp message for you to send. We’ll confirm availability, a quote and the booking details directly. An enquiry is not a confirmed reservation.

Can I collect a car near Tirana Airport?

Our base is near the airport, on Rruga Uzines in Krujë. Tell us your arrival plans so we can agree the exact collection point and time. Airport delivery and any related fees must be confirmed with the team.

What documents and deposit will I need?

Please ask the team to confirm licence requirements, minimum driver age, accepted identification, payment methods and the deposit for your chosen car. These details are agreed before your booking is confirmed.

Can I drive outside Albania?

Please discuss cross-border travel with us before booking. Permission, insurance coverage and any additional charges need to be confirmed for your vehicle and route.

What is included in the price?

Request a quote for your dates and car preference. The team will confirm the total price, insurance, mileage and fuel policies, any extras, and cancellation terms before you decide.

KEEPING THINGS SIMPLE

Privacy & enquiries

This site does not collect booking submissions or process payments. Your form details stay in your browser until you choose to continue to WhatsApp. WhatsApp then handles your message under its own privacy terms.

We use a session-only browser setting to remember that you have viewed the welcome screen. It clears when the browsing session ends. We do not add analytics or advertising cookies.

Google Maps, Instagram and TikTok links take you to those services, where their own privacy terms apply. The hosting provider may process standard technical information to serve the site.

For questions about your enquiry or personal information shared with the company, contact Auto Rental Kovaci on +355 68 900 0860.
